adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` on line 22 of groups_controller.rb, which accepts any client-provided limit value without an upper bound. A malicious user could pass an extremely large limit value (e.g., limit=1000000) to force the server to load and serialize a huge number of user records in a single request, potentially causing memory exhaustion or denial of service. This is a real security/performance defect introduced by this code.
